en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a broad European town square bordered by ornate 19th‑century buildings. The foreground shows an open, mostly unpaved square with a central fountain and elaborate gas streetlamps. Cobblestone streets run along the edges, with pedestrians in period clothing and a few horse‑drawn vehicles. The architectural style is late‑19th‑century Central European, with multi‑storey brick and stone facades, dormer windows, and steep tiled roofs. Some shop signs are faintly visible on the left and right sides of the square.
